title: Microsoft Purview: scan existing SharePoint and OneDrive files for sensitive information (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, scan behaviour, billing model and PowerShell call are supported by the sources checked. The two portal paths reach the correct pages but should include the final scope setting and pause toggle. Government-cloud behaviour and pricing remain appropriately qualified rather than presented as confirmed.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans administrator scanning of existing SharePoint and OneDrive for Business files at rest for sensitive data.
claims.quote: This new capability will enable admins to scan existing files at rest in SharePoint or OneDrive for business for sensitive data.
